name: Isaia
why: Neapolitan color and Aquaspider cloth — red-coral swagger.
origin: The Isaia family, Naples — from 1920s fabric trade to full tailoring house by 1957.
opview: Positions Neapolitan spirit — the red coral — as swagger you can tailor.

onething.n: live at Nordstrom — Sanita is the cut (named for the Naples district), Aquaspider the trademarked wool

notes.ital: Naples by way of Aversa, and the coral branch on the label is a local superstition against bad luck rather than a design motif. Soft shoulders, bright cloth, worn with visible pleasure.
notes.boat: Naples is a working port, so the association is native rather than aspirational — the brightness comes from the same place the boats do.

cities: NYC boutique · the full circuit — Boyds, Larrimor's, M Penner, Mario's, Halls, Mr. Sid

marks: House fabric names: Aquaspider, Aqua (water-repellent family), Storm, Scuba Wool Comfort, Filo di Corallo, Cashmoleskin, Cottoncash, Techno Cotton Silk, Fibra Carbonio. Licensed: Cashwool (Zegna Baruffa's extrafine merino yarn trademark). NO trademark symbols anywhere on the site.
